verdicts.reason: A: the can has shrunk to a tiny thumbnail jammed against the top edge, with the sun almost clipped and the SOLSTICE label unreadable. Its legal copy sits on the bottom-right decorative circle and is about 7px tall, and the hero product is now weaker than the logo. B: the logo sits inside a light-blue circle that is cut off at the canvas edge, and two circles compete across the top. Its can is also small with an illegible label and its legal text is still tiny, but the legal sits on a clean background and the top band looks more balanced. B is the less bad of the two.
